intent.description:
Polish and improve existing academic manuscript prose in its source language: Chinese
drafts stay Chinese and English drafts stay English unless the user explicitly requests
translation or a different output language. Use when the user asks to 润色、修改、精炼、
提升、精简、凝练、紧凑、压缩、polish, edit, tighten, compact, concise, or improve a draft, paragraph, abstract, introduction,
methods, results, discussion, conclusion, review article, thesis section, or NSFC/grant
passage. Preserve facts, numbers, units, citations, identifiers, terminology, claim
strength, voice, and paragraph structure. Do not use for translation-only, literature
search, citation verification, peer-review verdicts, statistical recalculation, or
LaTeX/DOCX layout repair.
intent.job_to_be_done: Polish existing academic prose in its detected Chinese or English language while preserving evidence, claims, terminology, and structure.
inputs: explicit journal, grant, or section preferences
outputs: polished passage in the routed language
optional audit findings or draft flags

should_trigger: 请润色下面这段中文论文引言，保持引用和数据不变。
Polish this English Results paragraph; preserve every p-value and citation.
把我的中文 NSFC 立项依据改得更凝练，保持原意。
Improve the English abstract of my academic manuscript for a journal submission without adding results.
请根据附件里的中文讨论部分做学术表达提升。
Polish the Methods section in English and retain all units and identifiers.
中英混杂的学术段落请按主要语言分别润色。
还是太啰嗦，请把上一版英文论文段落再压缩一轮。
请把这段中文医学论文结果改得更紧凑，保留 1,204 例、p<0.001 和 Figure 2。
Polish this English paragraph containing DOI:10.1234/abc and rs12345; keep both identifiers.
should_not_trigger: 把这篇论文翻译成英文。
请审稿这篇论文并给出接收建议。
请修复这篇论文的 LaTeX 排版和浮动体。
请查找支持这句话的文献。
帮我从零写一篇英文论文。
请推荐学术润色软件，不要编辑我的段落。
near_neighbor: 请审计论文中的引用是否真实存在。
请把论文改成 Nature 的 LaTeX 模板。
请根据结果撰写新的 Discussion。

router_rules: Detect the draft language, not the language of the user's instruction. Chinese prose
An explicit request such as “润色成英文” or “polish in English” overrides automatic
Ignore URLs, code, equations, citation brackets, file paths, and isolated technical IDs
Detect section and register only when supported by the text or the user's request. Use
Default mode is `polish`: edit existing prose without adding facts. Use `draft` only
compact_workflow: Read the whole supplied passage once for meaning, section function, claim strength,
Apply the shared evidence boundary in [core editing rules](references/core-editing-rules.md).
Load the detected language guide: [Chinese](references/zh-style.md) or
Put the point or finding early when this can be done without changing emphasis. Remove
Self-check protected tokens and evidence boundaries before answering. The deletion test
output_contract: In `polish` mode, return the polished text first. Preserve the original paragraph,
Then add `修改说明：` for a Chinese conversation or `Notes:` for an English conversation.
In `audit` mode, return concise findings and targeted repairs without silently rewriting
Keep the polished body in the source language by default. Notes may follow the language

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only source review; forbid unreviewed execution

permissions.network: none required for polishing; external lookup only when the user separately requests it
permissions.file_write: read-only by default; write a revised file only when the user explicitly requests it
permissions.subprocess: optional local language and token-preservation checks
permissions.interactive: ask only when language or scope is genuinely ambiguous

scaffold: frontmatter with natural Chinese and English polishing triggers
explicit exclusions for translation-only, peer review, literature search, and layout
production: automatic source-language routing with explicit override
shared evidence-preservation contract and language-specific rules
self-contained local validation and regression tests
prior-art, Skill IR, and creation-handoff evidence

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
